name: Banyan Tree Hangzhou
insider_take: This lakeside sanctuary sits on the shores of West Lake, a UNESCO World Heritage site that has inspired Chinese poets and painters for over 1,000 years.
whats_special: The resort features traditional Chinese architecture with private villas overlooking West Lake, complete with heated pools and spa pavilions. It's one of the few luxury properties directly on the lake's eastern shore, offering unobstructed views of the famous Ten Scenes of West Lake, including the iconic Three Pools Mirroring the Moon pagodas.
pro_tip: Book a lakefront villa and wake up at dawn to witness the ethereal morning mist rising from West Lake – it's the same view that inspired ancient Chinese landscape paintings.
dont_miss: Take a traditional wooden boat to explore the lake at sunset, visit the nearby Leifeng Pagoda for panoramic views, and experience authentic Hangzhou cuisine at the resort's restaurant featuring locally-sourced Longjing tea and West Lake fish in vinegar gravy.
pros: Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with signature Banyan Tree treatments
Stunning West Lake views and prime location near historic attractions
Elegant suites with traditional Chinese design elements and modern amenities
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Limited dining options within the hotel
